title: Architecture Exploration
description: Map RC12 authority boundaries and trust gates from RC11 final audit
findings: AIOS body owns local verification, quarantine, AgentCore, SecurityExecution, audit, rollback and support evidence; mirror/signer/frontend/object storage UI remain non-authoritative.

title: Implementation Exploration
description: Find RC11/RC10 planning and task artifact patterns
findings: Follow RC10/RC11 plan/session/task/evidence layout and script-per-task artifacts; ignored .workflow/artifacts results require forced add when committed.

title: Risk Exploration
description: Identify RC12 unblock risks and fail-closed requirements
findings: Primary risks are authority broadening, treating reachability as trust, stale/broad approvals, target spoofing, and accidental side effects before all gates are proved.
